history.content: ok so i finally did the thing i've been putting off for like 3 weeks, i called the dentist and booked the appointment, such a stupid small thing but it was sitting in my chest the whole time and now its just... gone. i feel weirdly calm. anyway just wanted to write it down somewhere
That sounds like a real release, especially after carrying it for three weeks. I’m glad you wrote it down here.

yeah exactly. its silly how a tiny phone call can feel like a mountain right? like the actual call was 2 minutes lol. the woman was really nice too. idk i just feel lighter, gonna make a cup of tea and sit for a bit
Yeah, the size of the task and the weight of it can be wildly different. I’m hearing a lighter, settled kind of calm, with a bit of tea-and-sit-down space around it.
yeah thats it exactly. ok thats all i wanted to put down really. thanks, this was nice. gonna go enjoy the quiet
I’m glad it found a little quiet with you. Take care for now.
